clips.send: Polar. Freezing cold almost all year. Warmest month below 10 degrees Celsius . Very little (mostly snow). Near the poles sunlight hits at a low, slanted angle and spreads out, so it is cold even in summer. Tundra: the ground stays frozen (permafrost); only mosses, lichens and small shrubs grow in the short summer. Ice cap: Antarctica and Greenland are buried under ice sheets up to 4 km thick. Polar bears, seals and penguins (Antarctica only). Very few people; the Inuit traditionally hunted and fished.

clips.send: Tropical. Hot all year, near the equator. Every month above 18 degrees Celsius . Very wet, or a wet + dry season. Near the equator the noon sun is high in the sky all year, so it is always hot. There is no real winter. Tropical wet (rainforest): heavy rain almost every day, like the Amazon and Congo basins. Tropical wet and dry (savanna): a long rainy season and a dry season, with grasslands and scattered trees. Rainforests hold over half of all plant and animal species. People grow bananas, cocoa, rice and rubber.

clips.send: Continental. Cold, snowy winters and warm summers. Coldest month below minus 3 degrees Celsius ; huge yearly range. Moderate, much of it in summer. Far from the ocean’s moderating effect, land heats up fast in summer and cools down fast in winter. Winters are long, snowy and freezing. Summers can be warm or even hot. The subarctic part has huge evergreen forests called taiga. It is found almost only in the Northern Hemisphere. Wheat and corn belts, dairy farms and forestry. Houses need strong heating for winter.

clips.send: Temperate (mild). Mild winters, warm or hot summers. Coldest month about minus 3 to 18 degrees Celsius . Moderate; rain in all or some seasons. Temperate climates have four seasons, but winters are mild, with only a little snow. Humid subtropical: hot, humid summers and mild winters. This is the climate of Atlanta and most of Georgia! Mediterranean: hot, dry summers and mild, rainy winters. Marine west coast (London): cool and rainy all year. Rich farmland for wheat, fruit, cotton and olives. Many of the world’s big cities are here.

clips.send: 温带（温和）气候。冬季温和，夏季温暖或炎热。最冷月约减3 摄氏度 到 18 摄氏度。降水适中，全年或某些季节有雨。温带气候四季分明，但冬季温和，很少下雪。亚热带湿润气候：夏季湿热，冬季温和。亚特兰大和佐治亚州大部分地区就是这种气候！地中海气候：夏季炎热干燥，冬季温和多雨。温带海洋性气候（如伦敦）：全年凉爽多雨。这里有肥沃的农田，出产小麦、水果、棉花和橄榄。世界上许多大城市都在这里。

clips.send: 热带气候。终年炎热，靠近赤道。每个月都高于 18 摄氏度。全年多雨，或分干季和湿季。赤道附近全年正午太阳都很高，所以终年炎热，没有真正的冬季。热带雨林气候：几乎天天下大雨，如亚马孙盆地和刚果盆地。热带草原气候：有漫长的雨季和干季，长着草原和稀疏的树木。热带雨林中生活着地球上一半以上的动植物物种。人们种植香蕉、可可、水稻和橡胶。

clips.send: 极地（寒带）气候。几乎全年严寒。最热月低于 10 摄氏度。很少（多为降雪）。两极附近阳光斜射，热量分散，所以即使是夏季也很冷。苔原：地下终年冻结（永久冻土），短暂的夏季里只长苔藓、地衣和矮小的灌木。冰原：南极洲和格陵兰被厚达 4 千米的冰盖覆盖。有北极熊、海豹，还有企鹅（只在南极）。人口极少；因纽特人传统上以狩猎和捕鱼为生。

clips.send: 温带大陆性气候。冬季寒冷多雪，夏季温暖。最冷月低于减3 摄氏度 ，气温年较差很大。降水适中，多集中在夏季。远离海洋的调节作用，陆地夏季升温快，冬季降温也快。冬季漫长、多雪、严寒；夏季温暖甚至炎热。靠北的亚寒带地区分布着广阔的常绿针叶林（泰加林）。这种气候几乎只出现在北半球。这里有小麦带和玉米带、奶牛场和林业。房屋冬天需要很好的供暖。
